glosses: to consume, to eat, to ingest
to devour, to gobble, to gorge, to stuff oneself (to eat greedily)
to eat up (to consume excessively some resources of energy or money)
to gnaw (to corrode; to fret away; to waste)
to eat away at (to take over and torment someone)
to sting (to puncture with the stinger)
to bring yourself to a state of extreme fatigue or loss of strength and health
to bring one another to a state of extreme fatigue or loss of strength and health
to become unusable or cease to exist

examples.text: Wczoraj zeżarłem pudełko pralin. Potem nie chciałem jeść obiadu.
